headline: Aditya Consumer Q2FY27: Loss narrows to ₹1.22 crore
summary: Aditya Consumer Marketing reported a standalone net loss of ₹1.22 crore for H1FY27, narrowing from ₹2.17 crore in the prior year period.

headline: Anand Rathi Wealth sees ₹181.45 crore block trade on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 800,740 shares of Anand Rathi Wealth was executed on BSE at ₹2,266.00 per share, aggregating to ₹181.45 crore.

headline: Globus Spirits Q2 net profit falls 39% YoY
summary: Globus Spirits reported a consolidated net profit of ₹142 million in Q2, down from ₹233 million YoY. Revenue rose to ₹7.6 billion while EBITDA margin contracted.

headline: GAIL Q2 net profit rises to ₹46.5B, beats estimates
summary: GAIL reported Q2 standalone net profit of ₹46.5 billion, up from ₹43 billion YoY and exceeding the ₹30 billion estimate. Revenue rose to ₹459 billion.

headline: Banaras Beads faces ₹26.24 lakh supplier claim
summary: Banaras Beads Ltd received a notice from the MSEFC Meerut regarding a ₹26.24 lakh claim by supplier Together Tech Pvt Ltd for unpaid goods and interest.

headline: Dhunseri Investments passes board resolution
summary: Dhunseri Investments Limited shareholders approved the appointment of Aditi Kanodia as Independent Director via postal ballot with 99.98% votes in favor.

headline: JK Agri Genetics Q2FY27: Net loss widens to ₹701 lakh
summary: JK Agri Genetics reported a net loss of ₹701.06 lakh in Q2FY27, widening from ₹509.08 lakh a year ago. Revenue from operations fell 24% YoY to ₹1,449.74 lakh.

headline: Bright Brothers Q2FY27 PAT falls 37% YoY
summary: Bright Brothers Ltd reported a 37% YoY decline in standalone net profit for Q2FY27 despite 18% revenue growth. Consolidated profit also fell as margins contracted.

headline: Mafatlal Industries fixes Nov 13 record date for interim dividend
summary: Mafatlal Industries Ltd has fixed November 13, 2026 as the record date for the consideration of interim dividend for FY27. The board meeting is scheduled for November 4, 2026.

headline: Bharat Gears Q2FY27: Profit falls 43%, auditor flags governance probe
summary: Bharat Gears reported a 43% YoY drop in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹4.10 crore. Revenue rose 16% to ₹238 crore, but auditor Deloitte issued a qualified review citing an ongoing impact assessment.

headline: GRT Jewellers acquires 74% stake in TBZ
summary: GRT Jewellers completes acquisition of 74.12% equity in Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri, triggering change of control and promoter de-classification.

headline: D.P. Abhushan opens first FOCO showroom in Jabalpur
summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited inaugurated its first Franchisee Owned Company Operated (FOCO) showroom in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, marking a strategic shift in retail expansion.

headline: Manika Plastech appoints Cygnus Partners as IR agency
summary: Manika Plastech Limited has appointed Cygnus Partners Private Limited as its Investor Relations agency effective November 1, 2026. The company also designated a new email for investor queries.

headline: Max Healthcare Q2 revenue up 21.8% YoY
summary: Max Healthcare Institute reported Q2 revenue of ₹26 billion, up from ₹21.35 billion. EBITDA margin improved to 27.7%, though net profit declined to ₹4.15 billion.

headline: Navin Fluorine Q2 profit jumps 82% to ₹2.7B
summary: Navin Fluorine International reported a net profit of ₹2.7 billion for Q2, up from ₹1.48 billion YoY, beating estimates of ₹2.3 billion. EBITDA margin expanded to 34.22%.

headline: Bajaj Finance allots ₹2,069.5 crore NCDs
summary: Bajaj Finance Limited allotted secured non-convertible debentures worth ₹2,069.5 crore on October 30, 2026. The issue features an 8.70% coupon rate across two tenures.

headline: GAIL extends Gurdaspur-Jammu pipeline deadline to Dec 2026
summary: GAIL extends Gurdaspur-Jammu pipeline completion to December 2026 due to forest permission delays in Punjab. No additional investment required for the revised schedule.

headline: GAIL revises pipeline completion to March 2027
summary: GAIL (India) Limited has revised the completion schedule for its Durgapur-Haldia and Dhamra-Haldia pipeline sections to March 2027 due to land acquisition delays.

headline: GAIL approves transfer of six CGD areas to subsidiary
summary: GAIL (India) Ltd board approved transferring Varanasi, Patna, Ranchi, East Singhbhum, Cuttack, and Khordha CGD areas to GAIL Gas Ltd via slump sale effective January 1, 2027.

headline: Apar Industries subsidiary acquires 70% stake in Chinese cable firm
summary: PSPL, a wholly owned subsidiary of Apar Industries, agreed to acquire 70% equity in Hebei Jinghuan Cable Co. Ltd for RMB 24.85 million to expand aluminium conductor manufacturing.

headline: Kamadgiri Fashion Q2FY27 Results: PAT jumps 650% YoY
summary: Kamadgiri Fashion Ltd reported a sharp rise in net profit to ₹88.59 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by strong revenue growth. However, operating cash flow turned negative due to inventory buildup.

headline: Omkar Overseas Q2FY27: Zero revenue, loss widens
summary: Omkar Overseas reported zero revenue for Q2FY27, posting a standalone loss of ₹3.39 lakh. Net debt increased as borrowings rose to ₹50.84 crore.

headline: GAIL extends KKBMPL pipeline completion to March 2027
summary: GAIL (India) Limited has extended the completion schedule for its Kochi-Koottanad-Bengaluru-Mangaluru pipeline project to March 2027. The extension is due to delays in land acquisition.

headline: GAIL board approves IPO of GAIL Gas
summary: GAIL board grants in-principle approval for GAIL Gas IPO, planning to dilute equity up to 25% via stock exchange listing.

headline: Pune E-Stock Broking H1FY27 Results
summary: Pune E-Stock Broking reports a 43% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹1,338.11 lakh for H1FY27, driven by strong revenue growth and higher other income.

headline: DMCC Q2FY27 Results: Net profit falls 44% YoY
summary: DMCC Speciality Chemicals reported a 44% YoY decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹3.21 crore despite revenue doubling. Margin contraction and rising finance costs drove the dip.

headline: Alna Trading Q2FY27: Revenue jumps 73%, profit up 20%
summary: Alna Trading & Exports reported a 73% YoY rise in quarterly revenue to ₹76.40 lakh. Net profit grew 20% to ₹0.60 lakh, driven by higher trading volumes.

headline: AVL Q2 net profit rises 42% YoY to 180M rupees
summary: AVL reported a net profit of 180M rupees in Q2, up from 127M rupees in the same period a year ago, marking a 42% YoY increase.

headline: Royal Orchid Hotels launches Z by Regenta in Vijayawada
summary: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd launched its new lifestyle hotel, Z by Regenta, in Vijayawada through subsidiary Regenta Hotels Private Limited on October 30, 2026.

headline: Vrundavan Plantation H1FY26 Results
summary: Vrundavan Plantation reports H1FY26 net profit of ₹101.20 lakh, down 19% YoY. Revenue rose 11% to ₹1,821.87 lakh. Trade receivables surged 35%, signaling collection pressure.

headline: SJVN Q2 net profit doubles to ₹6.6B
summary: SJVN reported a consolidated net profit of ₹6.6 billion in Q2, more than doubling from ₹3.1 billion YoY. Revenue surged to ₹22.44 billion from ₹10.3 billion.

headline: Nahar Spinning Q2 EBITDA jumps to ₹120 crore
summary: Nahar Spinning Mills reported a sharp rise in Q2 EBITDA to ₹120 crore from ₹25.8 crore YoY. Margins expanded significantly, and the company turned profitable.

headline: Vadilal Industries Q2 net profit rises to ₹550 million
summary: Vadilal Industries reported a consolidated net profit of ₹550 million in Q2, up from ₹334 million YoY. Revenue grew to ₹4.63 billion with EBITDA margin expanding to 18.12%.

headline: Bihar Sponge Iron faces High Court notice
summary: Bihar Sponge Iron received a Delhi High Court notice in arbitration case Vanraj Steels v. Bihar Sponge Iron. Hearing scheduled for November 19, 2026.

headline: A-1 Ltd Q2FY27 Results: PAT jumps 2268% YoY
summary: A-1 Limited reported a sharp surge in Q2FY27 profits, with net profit rising 2268% YoY to ₹1.65 lakh. Revenue from operations grew significantly, driven by strong demand in the chemicals segment.

headline: Sudarshan Pharma approves ₹72 crore warrant issue
summary: Sudarshan Pharma Industries board approved a preferential issue of 72 crore warrants to promoters Hemal and Sachin Mehta. The move aims to raise funds subject to shareholder approval.

headline: Piramal Finance Q2FY27 PAT up 67% to ₹545 crore
summary: Piramal Finance reported a 67% YoY rise in net profit to ₹545 crore in Q2FY27. AUM grew 24% YoY to ₹1.13 lakh crore, with retail AUM up 30%. Growth business RoAUM improved to 2.0%.

headline: Ardee Industries FY26 Results: PAT jumps 155% to ₹84.7 crore
summary: Ardee Industries reported a 154.5% surge in net profit to ₹84.68 crore for FY26. Revenue grew 57.2% to ₹1,167.65 crore, driven by higher volumes and improved margins.

headline: 360 ONE holds 7.28% in Paras Healthcare post-IPO
summary: 360 ONE Asset Management disclosed a 7.28% stake in Paras Healthcare following IPO listing, with no new shares acquired during the period.

headline: HP Cotton Textile Q2FY27 Profit Up 34% YoY
summary: HP Cotton Textile Mills reported a 34% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹106 lakh, despite flat revenue. Working capital pressures emerged as trade receivables doubled.

headline: Supreme Court upholds Som Distilleries licence renewal
summary: The Supreme Court reaffirmed the High Court order allowing Som Distilleries to renew manufacturing licences, enabling the resumption of operations at its Bhopal plant.

headline: Vinay Kumar Singh acquires 5.69% stake in Thrive Future Habitats
summary: Vinay Kumar Singh acquired 11,73,451 shares of Thrive Future Habitats Limited via warrant conversion, raising his holding to 5.69%. The company's share capital increased to ₹20.63 crore.

headline: Sun Pharma appoints Deloitte as statutory auditors
summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd board approved Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP as statutory auditors for five years from FY27 AGM, replacing SRBC & CO LLP.

headline: SJVN board approves merger of thermal subsidiary
summary: SJVN Limited's board approved the merger of wholly owned subsidiary SJVN Thermal Private Limited. The move aims to consolidate operations and reduce compliance costs.

headline: Aditya Vision Q2FY27 PAT jumps 38% YoY
summary: Aditya Vision Ltd reported a 38% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹18 crore. Revenue from operations grew 28% YoY to ₹586 crore, driven by strong retail demand.

headline: Jayatma Enterprises Q2FY27 posts net loss
summary: Jayatma Enterprises reported a net loss of ₹4.19 lakh in Q2FY27, down from a profit of ₹15.90 lakh in the year-ago quarter. Revenue from operations was nil.

headline: Kenvi Jewels Q2FY27 PAT falls 60% YoY
summary: Kenvi Jewels Ltd reported a 60% YoY drop in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹14.70 lakh. Revenue from operations declined sharply by 60% to ₹1,821.80 lakh.

headline: Rikhav Securities to host H1FY27 earnings call
summary: Rikhav Securities Ltd will host an investor and analyst conference call on November 6, 2026, to discuss its financial performance for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: White Hall Commercial Q2FY27: Loss narrows to ₹0.90 lakh
summary: White Hall Commercial reported a net loss of ₹0.90 lakh for Q2FY27, narrowing from ₹2.46 lakh in the year-ago quarter. The company recorded zero operating income, with losses driven by employee and other expenses.

headline: Kaya Ltd raises ₹50 crore via preferential allotment
summary: Kaya Limited allotted 18.24 lakh equity shares at ₹274.10 each to Axana Estates and Plutus Investments, raising ₹49.99 crore. Paid-up capital increases to ₹17.01 crore.

headline: String Metaverse allots 1.67 crore shares at ₹8.85
summary: String Metaverse Limited allotted 1,67,57,058 equity shares on a preferential basis for ₹14.83 crore. The issue price was ₹8.85 per share, raising capital from 14 non-promoter allottees.

headline: Gita Renewable Q2FY27 Results: Loss narrows to ₹7.16 lakh
summary: Gita Renewable Energy Limited reported a standalone net loss of ₹7.16 lakh for Q2FY27, narrowing from ₹8.86 lakh in the year-ago period. Revenue from operations remained nil.

headline: Waaree Energies subsidiary starts 1.6 GW Texas production
summary: Waaree Solar Americas commenced commercial production of 1.6 GW solar modules in Texas. This doubles the Brookshire facility's capacity to 3.2 GW annually.

headline: Foundry Fuel Q2FY27: Loss widens, net worth negative
summary: Foundry Fuel Products reported a standalone loss of ₹5.49 lakh for Q2FY27 with zero revenue. Net worth remains negative at ₹160.64 crore, driven by administrative costs and borrowings.

headline: Borosil Renewables Q2FY27: Net profit up 11.7% YoY
summary: Borosil Renewables reported a 11.7% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹68.78 crore for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 4.7% YoY to ₹396.70 crore.

headline: Zee Q2FY27: Profit jumps 168% YoY to ₹2,098 mn
summary: Zee Entertainment net profit rose 168% YoY to ₹2,098 million in Q2FY27. Revenue grew 11.7% to ₹20,638 million. Board approved financial results and warrant allotment.

headline: V-Mart Retail: Promoter group members seek reclassification
summary: V-Mart Retail Ltd received requests from Raghav and Ditya Agarwal to move from Promoter Group to Public category. Board meeting scheduled for Nov 3, 2026.

headline: Continental Securities Q2FY27 Net Profit Rises 38% YoY
summary: Continental Securities Ltd reported a 38% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹76.41 lakh. Interest income grew 28%, driving strong operational performance.

headline: HRS Aluglaze H1FY27 PAT falls 58% YoY
summary: HRS Aluglaze Limited reported a 58% YoY decline in standalone net profit for H1FY27. Revenue rose 20%, but margin compression and rising costs impacted profitability.

headline: JK Agri Genetics sells land rights to Sai Life Sciences for ₹19.80 crore
summary: JK Agri Genetics Ltd board approved the transfer of leasehold rights for non-operational land in Telangana to Sai Life Sciences for ₹19.80 crore. The move aims to strengthen cash flow.

headline: Shah Alloys Q2FY27: Loss widens, auditor flags going concern
summary: Shah Alloys reported a net loss of ₹1.85 crore for Q2FY27 as revenue from operations hit zero. Auditors issued a material uncertainty regarding the company's going concern status following the plant closure.

headline: Colgate India seeks shareholder nod for new MD & CEO
summary: Colgate-Palmolive (India) Ltd has initiated a postal ballot to appoint Manish Anandani as MD & CEO. Voting is open from October 31 to November 29, 2026.

headline: Rishi Techtex discloses H1FY26 related party deals
summary: Rishi Techtex Limited reported ₹3,756.62 lakh in goods purchases from Centennial Fabrics for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Total related party transaction value stood at ₹4,121.15 lakh.

headline: FX Multitech board meeting postponed to Nov 4
summary: FX Multitech Ltd postponed its Q2FY27 board meeting from Oct 30 to Nov 4, 2026. The delay is due to statutory auditors needing more time to finalize reports.

headline: Engineers India Q2 net profit rises 136% YoY
summary: Engineers India Ltd reported a consolidated net profit of ₹1.97 billion in Q2, up from ₹835 million YoY. EBITDA margin expanded to 23.51% despite revenue decline.

headline: Oriental Aromatics signs strategic deal with Unilever
summary: Oriental Aromatics enters non-exclusive strategic, technical, and manufacturing arrangement with Unilever Industries. No consideration disclosed; aims for synergy.

headline: BSE grants no-objection for Ekansh Concepts merger
summary: Ekansh Concepts Limited received a no-objection certificate from BSE for its merger with Sankalp Industrial Infratech Private Limited. The scheme now awaits NCLT approval.

headline: Suraj Estate Developers revises earnings call time
summary: Suraj Estate Developers Limited has revised the time for its Q2FY27 earnings conference call to 3:30 PM IST on November 2, 2026. The change was notified to NSE and BSE.

headline: Deepankar Barat raises stake in Milkfood to 6.47%
summary: Deepankar Barat increased his holding in Milkfood Ltd from 2.73% to 6.47% via preferential allotment of 11 lakh shares at ₹30 each on October 30, 2026.

headline: Amalgamated Electricity Q2FY27 Loss Widens to ₹29.74 Lakh
summary: Amalgamated Electricity Company Ltd reported a standalone net loss of ₹29.74 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹4.60 lakh in Q2FY26. Zero operating revenue persisted as finance costs and depreciation rose.

headline: PNGS Reva opens new Pune store, takes EBOs to 6
summary: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery opened an exclusive brand store in Pune on October 30, 2026. This brings its total exclusive brand stores to six, alongside 34 SIS stores.

headline: IOC Q2 EBITDA jumps to ₹302.96B from ₹25.60B
summary: Indian Oil Corporation reported a massive QoQ swing in EBITDA to ₹302.96B, with net profit turning positive at ₹216.3B despite a slight revenue dip.

headline: Shivalik Bimetal to decide bonus, dividend
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd board meeting on November 6, 2026, will consider bonus shares and interim dividend for FY27. Trading window closed until then.

headline: Snehjeev Ventures crosses 13% stake in Amerise
summary: Snehjeev Ventures and persons acting in concert crossed the 13% holding threshold in Amerise Biosciences after acquiring 18,342 equity shares on October 28, 2026.

headline: Garbi Finvest CS resigns over personal reasons
summary: Garbi Finvest Limited announced the resignation of Richa Agarwalla as Company Secretary, Compliance Officer, and Nodal Officer due to unavoidable personal reasons.

headline: Dixon Q2 net profit falls 48.8% YoY
summary: Dixon Technologies reported a 48.8% YoY decline in consolidated net profit to ₹3.43 billion in Q2, despite revenue rising 46.7% to ₹217.94 billion.

headline: Kajaria Ceramics acquires 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar
summary: Kajaria Ceramics subscribed to equity shares of Sunsure Solarpark Fourty Three Private Limited for ₹1.21 crore, securing a 19.77% stake to power its Rajasthan plants.

headline: Technojet approves capital hike, preferential issue
summary: Technojet Consultants approved an increase in authorized share capital and a preferential issue of equity shares to non-promoters during its EGM on October 30, 2026.

headline: HDFC MF raises stake in PB Fintech to 7.03%
summary: HDFC Mutual Fund increased its holding in PB Fintech by 2.02% via open market purchases, bringing total stake to 7.03% as of October 28, 2026.

headline: Shree Renuka Sugars Q2FY27: Loss narrows to ₹1,632 crore
summary: Shree Renuka Sugars reported a standalone net loss of ₹1,632 million for Q2FY27, narrowing from ₹3,188 million in the year-ago quarter. Revenue fell 25% YoY.

headline: NFL appoints Inderpreet Singh as Executive Director
summary: National Fertilizers Limited promotes Inderpreet Singh to Executive Director effective November 1, 2026, succeeding T.K. Batra who retires upon superannuation.

headline: Indo US Bio-Tech Q2FY27 Results: Loss widens to ₹367 lakh
summary: Indo US Bio-Tech reported a net loss of ₹367.14 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from a profit in the previous quarter. Revenue fell 51% YoY to ₹1,504.63 lakh.

headline: Aether Industries uploads Q2FY27 earnings call audio
summary: Aether Industries has uploaded the audio recording of its Q2FY27 earnings conference call to its website, complying with SEBI listing regulations.

headline: Siemens Energy India CFO resigns for global role
summary: Satyajit Ghosh, Execution Unit Finance Head at Siemens Energy India, resigned effective October 30, 2026, to join the Siemens Energy AG group.

headline: Hindustan Copper faces new appeal in IVRCL consortium case
summary: IVRCL-MCCDL-TCL-DM Consortium has filed Misc. Petition No. 6506/2026 before the Madhya Pradesh High Court, Jabalpur, challenging a stay order. Next hearing is December 14, 2026.

headline: Ratnaveer Q2 net profit rises 56% to ₹241 million
summary: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering reported a 56% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to ₹241 million, driven by 35% revenue growth. EBITDA margin contracted slightly to 9.42%.

headline: Ramkrishna Forgings turns profitable in Q2
summary: Ramkrishna Forgings posted a consolidated net profit of 706M rupees in Q2, reversing a loss of 95M rupees in the same period last year, marking a sharp YoY turnaround.

headline: LIC announces superannuation of four senior officials
summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India confirmed the retirement of three Executive Directors and one Zonal Manager effective October 31, 2026, under SEBI regulations.

headline: Shekhawati Industries enters dev agreement
summary: Shekhawati Industries signed a development agreement for a 2,00,000 sq. ft. residential and commercial project in Karjat, Maharashtra, marking its expansion into real estate.

headline: West Leisure Resorts cites exemption from RPT disclosure
summary: West Leisure Resorts Ltd declared non-applicability of SEBI Regulation 23(9) for H1FY26. Paid-up capital and net worth remained below threshold limits.

headline: Shreeji Translogistics Q2FY27: PAT jumps 109%, declares dividend
summary: Shreeji Translogistics reported a 109% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹153.69 lakh. Revenue grew 9.2% YoY. The board declared an interim dividend of ₹0.05 per share.

headline: Asian Energy Services Q2FY27 PAT jumps to ₹1,707 lakh
summary: Asian Energy Services reported a consolidated net profit of ₹1,707.09 lakh for Q2FY27, up from a loss in the prior year period. Revenue surged 161% YoY to ₹26,667.45 lakh.

headline: Pudumjee Paper Q2 EBITDA rises 14% YoY
summary: Pudumjee Paper Products reported a 14% YoY rise in Q2 EBITDA to ₹311 million. Net profit grew to ₹227 million, driven by revenue expansion.

headline: GE Vernova T&D Q2 profit rises 43% to ₹4.3B
summary: GE Vernova T&D reported a 43% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to ₹4.3B, driven by 32% revenue growth and expanded EBITDA margins.

headline: Waaree Renewable transfers subsidiary to parent
summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies completed the transfer of 100% equity in Waaree Green Data Centers to Waaree Energies on October 30, 2026.

headline: Piramal Pharma to host investor meets in Nov
summary: Piramal Pharma Limited will hold institutional investor meetings on November 17 and 18, 2026, in Mumbai, arranged by Avendus Spark and JM Financial.
